name: Release pipelines for nox, nyx, chaos, cosmos and mist
body: Dean (2026-11-17): each tool repo gets a staging branch that everyone pushes to and pulls from, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs only when staging is merged into the release branch (proto for nox, nyx, chaos and cosmos; main for mist), so active work does not flood the runners. The pipeline builds, runs the tests and publishes the prebuilt tools as a rolling release (proto-latest) that the Lantern cloud bootstrap and the Mac can download. Needs Actions enabled on each repo and a FEARLESS_READ_TOKEN secret with read access to the private repos, which only Dean can add. Linux x86-64 first; macOS arm64 is a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Each repo has a staging branch and .github/workflows/release.yml that triggers on push to its release branch only
A merge into the release branch builds, tests and publishes a proto-latest release with the tools and a sha256
Each repo's instructions say to work on staging
questions: Which secret holds the read token, and does Actions need turning on for each repo?
